verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Quantum channel discrimination has been studied from an information-theoretic perspective, wherein one is interested in the optimal decay rate of error probabilities as a function of the number of unknown channel accesses. verdicts.title: Tianyan: Cloud services with quantum advantage
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Tianyan Quantum Cloud Platform offers cloud services demonstrating quantum advantage capabilities with a Zuchongzhi 3.0-like superconducting quantum processor.
